subject: a Russian count and writer with a broad strong face, deep-set grey eyes under thick bushy eyebrows, a large nose and a full beard, wearing a loose belted Russian peasant blouse (rubashka) and plain trousers

panels.01-estate: a country estate in central Russia in 1828, a white two-storey manor house with columns at the end of a long avenue of birch trees, two small side wings, a pond and rolling fields, summer morning, wide quiet establishing shot, early 19th century Russia
panels.02-sevastopol: {S} as a young artillery officer of 26 with a short dark beard, in a dark 1850s Russian army greatcoat and cap, sitting on an ammunition crate inside an earthwork bastion at night, writing in a small notebook by the light of a lantern, cannons and gabions around him, distant glow on the horizon, Crimean War 1855, calm and thoughtful, no fighting and no blood
panels.03-school: {S} at age 31 with a dark beard, standing in a simple wooden schoolroom in a small country house in 1859, surrounded by a lively group of Russian peasant children in homespun shirts and headscarves, some sitting on benches and some on the floor, a boy reading aloud from a slate, Tolstoy listening with a warm smile, books and a stove, natural light, joy of learning
panels.04-warandpeace: {S} at age 37 with a full dark beard, writing at a large wooden desk piled with manuscript pages in a study at night by candlelight, his young wife in an 1860s dark dress with her hair parted in the middle sitting at a small table nearby carefully copying out the pages by hand, stacks of paper everywhere, bookshelves behind, Russia 1865, intense creative focus
panels.05-famine: {S} at age 63 with a long grey beard, in a sheepskin coat and fur cap, helping hand out bowls of hot soup and loaves of bread from a big pot inside a plain log hut to Russian village families in winter clothes, snow outside the open door, 1891, compassion and dignity, no suffering shown graphically
panels.06-gandhi: an elderly {S} with a long white beard, seated at a simple wooden desk by a window in a country house study in 1909, reading a handwritten letter with a stamp from South Africa, a newspaper and an envelope beside him, an inkwell and pen ready for his reply, autumn light, quiet thought
panels.07-departure: an elderly {S} with a long white beard, in a long dark coat and cap, walking with a walking stick toward a waiting horse-drawn carriage at the edge of a country estate in the grey light of late autumn 1910, a doctor with a small bag beside him, bare trees, fallen leaves, the house behind, solemn and quiet
panels.08-grave: a small simple grassy grave mound with no cross or stone in a quiet clearing at the edge of a ravine in an old oak and birch forest, autumn leaves, soft sunlight through the trees, a few visitors in 1920s clothes standing respectfully at a distance holding wildflowers, peace and remembrance
